description: Register an alternative under a proposed decision point (BL-70): a lightweight Artifact pointer that names where the alternative's design export lives (branch-by-file), GOVERNED_BY the Decision and CONTRADICTS its siblings. Refuses unless the Decision is `proposed` — you fork an open choice, not a settled one. Compare the registered alternatives with analyze_alternatives, then collapse_decision to choose. A ROUTE UNDER A PROOF HOLE says, in the same call, what would refute it (`refuter`), or that it is an untried branch charted at the fork (`waiting: true`) with its stated promise (`promise`, `promise_rank`): reasoning_report's search map reads it as open, waiting or failed, and ranks the untried branches.

artifact_id.description: Id for the alternative pointer (an Artifact), e.g. `alt:laser`.

decision_id.description: The proposed Decision this alternative is a fork of.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

location.description: Where the alternative's design export lives (branch-by-file).

name.description: A short human name for the alternative — the road, not the file — as it will appear in `alternatives_for` and `analyze_alternatives`.

promise.description:
FOR A ROUTE UNDER A PROOF HOLE: ITS STATED PROMISE, in a short line —
why it is on the chart and how promising it looks (a bone, a source, a
near result). Optional while it waits; written before it is worked.

promise_rank.description:
FOR A ROUTE UNDER A PROOF HOLE: ITS ROUGH RANK, 1 the most promising.
The search map orders the untried branches anywhere on the chart by
whether closing them could close the target first, then by this rank,
then the higher fork. Left out: unranked, after the ranked ones.

refuter.description:
FOR A ROUTE UNDER A PROOF HOLE: WHAT RESULT WOULD SHOW IT CANNOT CLOSE
THE HOLE, written before it is worked — a counterexample to its key
lemma, a barrier to its method, its step reading circular. The search
map shows it beside the open route. Revise it with add_artifact.

waiting.description:
FOR A ROUTE UNDER A PROOF HOLE: `true` CHARTS IT AS AN UNTRIED BRANCH,
listed and not yet worked. Chart every candidate at a fork this way,
one line each, unfiltered: no reason is needed to list one, only to
work it. The search map lists it as waiting, ranked by its promise.
Open it with add_artifact `waiting: null`, writing its `refuter`.

name: register_alternative
title: Register an Alternative
